_about: Canonical strings for mitothrum.com (RULES.md 0.4, MITO-REGISTRY). This file owns the exact approved text; RULES.md owns the policy and conditions. Pages, templates and checks read these values, and any mismatch fails validation (from PR 3). Change a string here and in the pages in the same PR. Lives under .github/ so it is never deployed or served.

AMAZON_TAG.note: Or a page-specific tracking ID created in Associates Central (RULES.md 1.1)

AMAZON_ASSOCIATE_LINE.text: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

NOT_MEDICAL_ADVICE.where: Every page; the footer may continue with the longer sentence below
NOT_MEDICAL_ADVICE.footer_continuation: Nothing on this site diagnoses, treats, or prevents any condition; talk to your doctor about health decisions.

GROUP_DISCLOSURE_PLURAL.text: Mitothrum may earn a commission if you buy through these links — at no extra cost to you.
GROUP_DISCLOSURE_PLURAL.where: Directly above each group of two or more affiliate links

GROUP_DISCLOSURE_SINGULAR.text: Mitothrum may earn a commission if you buy through this link — at no extra cost to you.
GROUP_DISCLOSURE_SINGULAR.where: Directly above a single affiliate link

PRICE_LINK_TEXT.where: Affiliate link text; never a printed price

WARRANTY_NOTE.where: Beside any warranty or guarantee mention, linking the brand's policy

social._about: Social pre-check (social_check.py) strings, from marketing/SOCIAL.md. Exact text; change here and in SOCIAL.md together.

SOCIAL_DISCLOSURE_FIRST_LINE.text: I earn commissions on purchases made through links in this post.
SOCIAL_DISCLOSURE_FIRST_LINE.where: First line of every post that mentions a product or links product pages, plus #ad
